KNOWN_UNOBSERVABLE.tokenId: No token id exists in source. Stable identity = startedAtMs (monotonic KKA() at creation).
KNOWN_UNOBSERVABLE.cancelReasonPersisted: ngA(e) discards its argument; the pin records the RAW entry parameter only. A recorded reasonArg is the caller argument, not a stored token field.
KNOWN_UNOBSERVABLE.bedAutomationEndpoints: Gq is a callback reference; the pin proves INVOCATION and its (storyLeads,atTime,4.5s) arguments. The bed callback body is a separate function and is NOT pinned, so the realised bed AudioParam endpoints are not directly measured here.
KNOWN_UNOBSERVABLE.pcmAlignment: Owned-sink WAV start is not proven to coincide with the recorder wall start; no PCM/event alignment or audible claim may be derived from these events.

PERTURBATION_LIMITS.deoptimization: Setting a CDP breakpoint on a minified function forces V8 to deoptimize and reparse that function; LY/mMA/hwe run slower than in an uninstrumented build. Per-frame deadline observations therefore carry an unquantified positive timing bias. Do not report a sub-frame overshoot as exact.
PERTURBATION_LIMITS.nonPausing: All conditions terminate in ,!1 so the debugger never pauses; no gameplay stall.
PERTURBATION_LIMITS.readOnly: No game state assignment, no setter or AudioParam wrapping, no forced pause flag.
